title: > Hidayet Aksu, Badih Ghazi, Pritish Kamath, Ravi Kumar, Pasin Manurangsi,
summary: Code for optimizing summary reports in the privacy-sandbox attribution reporting API: given train and test dataframes with slice columns, value columns, and a count column, it optimizes the privacy-budget allocation and scores the result with RMSRE-tau error metrics. Includes a synthetic dataset generator.
